name: Francisco de Zurbarán

summary.text: Francisco de Zurbarán was a Spanish Baroque painter known for his religious paintings depicting monks, nuns and martyrs, and for his still lifes. Zurbarán made forceful use of chiaroscuro, in which he excelled.
summary.title: Francisco de Zurbarán

518940: The Immaculate Conception is a painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, executed in 1632, conserved at the National Art Museum of Catalonia.
2361683: Saint Hugh in the Carthusian Refectory is a painting of 1655 by Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville.
Saint Hugh in the Carthusian Refectory
3221342: Christ on the Cross is a 1627 oil painting on canvas by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Art Institute of Chicago.
3464088: Saint Serapion or The Martyrdom of Saint Serapion is a 1628 oil painting on canvas by the Spanish artist Francisco Zurbarán (1598–1664). The work was commissioned by the Mercedarian Order to hang in the De Profundis hall of their monastery in Seville.
3464453: Saint Agatha is a 1630–1633 painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, bought by the French town of Montpellier in 1852 for 1540 francs and now in the city's Musée Fabre.
3464529: Saint Margaret of Antioch is a painting of 1631 by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán now in the National Gallery, London, which bought it in 1903.
4693305: Agnus Dei is an oil painting completed between 1635 and 1640 by the Spanish Baroque artist Francisco de Zurbarán. It is housed in the Prado Museum in Madrid, Spain.
5403305: Saint Andrew is a painting of 1635–1640 by Francisco de Zurbarán of the apostle Andrew. Since 1949 it has been part of the collection of the Museum of Fine Arts in Budapest, Hungary.
5701651: The Apotheosis of Saint Thomas Aquinas is a 1631 altarpiece painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, originally painted for the Dominican College of Seville, but now in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville. It is Zurbarán's largest composition.
The Apotheosis of Saint Thomas Aquinas
5801323: The Defence of Cádiz is a painting in oils on canvas by Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Museo del Prado in Madrid.
The Defence of Cádiz Against the English
5906548: Hercules Fighting the Nemean Lion is a work of 1634 by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán. It is conserved in the Museo del Prado.
5906551: Hercules and the Hydra is a 1634 painting by Francisco de Zurbarán of Hercules fighting the Lernaean Hydra, now in the Prado Museum in Madrid. It was from a series of the Labours of Hercules for the Hall of Realms in Madrid's Palacio del Buen Retiro.
5965525: The Virgin Mary as a Child Praying is a 1658–1660 painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Hermitage Museum in St Petersburg. Its theme is similar to that of his The Young Virgin.
The Virgin Mary as a Child Praying
5966034: The House in Nazareth is a 1630 oil on canvas painting by the Spanish artist Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Cleveland Museum of Art. Zurbaran also produced other variants on the same theme using a similar composition.
6025833: The Death of Hercules is a 1634 painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Museo del Prado in Madrid. It belonged to a series of ten paintings on the life of Hercules for the Hall of Realms at the Palacio del Buen Retiro.
6034540: Saint Apollonia is a 1636 oil-on-canvas painted by the Spanish artist Francisco de Zurbarán. It is currently held and exhibited at the Louvre in Paris.
6119249: Saint Luke Painting the Crucifixion is an oil on canvas painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, executed c. 1650, also known as Crucifixion with Saint Luke or The Crucified Christ with a Painter. It is now in the Prado Museum.
6145103: Displaying the Body of Saint Bonaventure is a 1629 oil painting on canvas by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Louvre. Around the body of Saint Bonaventure are figures including James I of Aragon and Pope Gregory X, shown in conversation.
Displaying the Body of Saint Bonaventure
6163639: The Young Virgin or The Virgin Mary as a Child in Ecstasy is a 1632-1633 painting by Francisco de Zurbarán. It is now in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York.
6163933: The Vision of Saint Alphonsus Rodriguez is a 1630 oil painting on canvas by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando in Madrid. It shows a vision of Jesuit Saint Alphonsus Rodriguez.
The Vision of Saint Alphonsus Rodriguez
7617092: Still Life with Lemons, Oranges and a Rose is an oil-on-canvas painting by Baroque Spanish artist Francisco de Zurbarán completed in 1633. It is currently displayed at the Norton Simon Museum in Pasadena, California as part of its permanent collection.
Still Life with Lemons, Oranges and a Rose
8202299: Saint Peter Nolasco's Vision of Saint Peter the Apostle is a 1629 oil painting on canvas by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Prado Museum in Madrid. It is signed at the bottom FRANCISCUS Đ ZURBARAN/ FACIEBAT.
Saint Peter Nolasco's Vision of Saint Peter the Apostle
9094523: The Vision of Saint Peter Nolasco is a 1629 oil-on-canvas painting by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Museo del Prado in Madrid.
The Vision of Saint Peter Nolasco
15874376: The Archangel Gabriel is a 1634 painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Musée Fabre in Montpellier.
15943274: Saint Elizabeth of Portugal is an oil painting on canvas executed ca. 1630–1635 by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán. It depicts Queen Saint Elizabeth of Portugal, daughter of Peter III of Aragon and wife of Denis of Portugal.
16674796: Saint Francis in Ecstasy is an oil painting on canvas of 1658–1660 by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán in the Alte Pinakothek in Munich, where it has been since 1836.
18572814: Annunciation is a 1638–1639 oil on canvas painting by Francisco de Zurbarán, now in the Museum of Grenoble, to which it was given by Léon de Beylié in 1901.
19947676: Saint Francis is an oil painting of 1659 by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán depicting Saint Francis of Assisi. It was the only work by the artist known in France before the 19th century.
21725315: Saint Lawrence is an oil painting on canvas executed ca. 1636–1639 by the Spanish painter Francisco de Zurbarán. It has been in the Hermitage Museum in St Petersburg since the 19th century.
24843240: Hercules Separates Mounts Calpe and Abylla is a work by Francisco de Zurbarán, created in 1634.
Hercules Separates Mounts Calpe and Abylla
28113310: Jacob and his twelve sons is a series of thirteen paintings by Spanish artist Francisco de Zurbarán.
87068900: Saint Francis of Assisi in His Tomb is an oil-on-canvas painting by the Spanish Baroque artist Francisco de Zurbarán, created between 1630 and 1634.
Saint Francis of Assisi in His Tomb
113574260: Still Life with Pots is the title of two 1650 paintings by Francisco de Zurbarán. The autograph version is now in the Museo del Prado, to which it was donated in 1940 by the collector Francesc Cambó.
